source: Hand-drawn churchyard survey plan (page 9 of the digitised PDF), approximate grid positions traced from the original graph-paper sketch
unit: Each grid position is an integer grid-cell index (col increasing eastward, row increasing southward from the sketch's top-left corner), one per intersection of the original graph-paper grid. Individual memorials' plot positions are given by the col/row front matter on the memorial's own file in monumental-inscriptions/; this file holds only the plan's drawn geometry (features) and section labels.
